description: This file defines a command handler class for creating share accounts within the Fineract platform. It implements the process of handling a specific command type and delegates the creation logic to a service.

classes.name: CreateShareAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles the creation of share accounts by processing commands and delegating to the share account service.

methods.name: CreateShareAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ShareAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to create a share account by invoking the service.
